column1: # OWASP ZAP Baseline Security Scan — Rules Configuration
# Format: <rule-id>\t<action>\t<url-regex>
# Actions: IGNORE | INFO | WARN | FAIL
# Note: Exactly 3 tab-separated columns are required by zap-baseline.py parser
# 10055: Content Security Policy (CSP) Alerts (unsafe-inline / unsafe-eval / wildcard)
# Required by Next.js client hydration and DuckDB-Wasm in-browser analytical OLAP
# 90003: Sub Resource Integrity (SRI) Attribute Missing
# Next.js 16 App Router builds and hashes same-origin local chunks (_next/static/...)
# 10031: User Controllable HTML Element Attribute (Potential XSS)
# Search keywords, categories, and auth redirects are safely sanitized and rendered in UI controls
# 10094: Base64 Disclosure
# React Server Components (RSC) flight data serialization and base64 SVG icons
# 90005: Sec-Fetch-* Headers Missing (Fetch Metadata Request Headers)
# Passive detection for modern browser Sec-Fetch metadata headers in server responses
# 10111: Authentication Request Identified
# Passive identification of authentication endpoints (/sign-in, /sign-up); normal application behavior
# 10049: Non-Storable Content / Storable Content (Cache-Control)
# Protected routes (/checkout, /dashboard, /seller) strictly enforce no-store/private cache controls
# 10109: Modern Web Application
# Informational detection that site is built on modern framework (Next.js / React App Router)
# 10044: Big Redirect Detected
# Edge Middleware intercepts unauthenticated routes with 0-byte fast redirects
# 10019: Content-Type Header Missing
# All route handlers and redirects must return explicit Content-Type headers
# 10202: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens
# All interactive state-modifying forms must provide CSRF tokens
